title: Why OpenAI Needs $100 Billion in New Funding — 2026-02-19
description: OpenAI is reportedly on the verge of securing a $100 billion funding round, raising questions about its valuation and future plans. In this episode, we explore why OpenAI might need such a staggering amount of capital and what this means for the AI industry. We also discuss the implications of billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller's recent stock moves, including selling Meta and investing in an AI stock that has skyrocketed 210,000% since its IPO.
